book.title: What Changed
book.subtitle: Reading diffs, for the machines that review them
book.audience: Language-model agents that read diffs — reviewing, summarizing, or gating changes — and the people who supervise them; assumes the ability to read a unified diff and no git-internals knowledge.

chapters.title: A Diff Is Not a State
The Base You Did Not Choose
The Summary That Disagrees With Itself

grounded_in.reference: authoring-machine transcripts 2026-08-29 (Gentoo, git listings in scratch repositories with pinned identity and dates), reproduced in the text as real outputs

tools: git + bash (listing execution during authoring, scratch repositories)
O'AILLY pass1 gate (local runs during authoring; word measurement via the gate's counter)
.listings/verify.py (re-executes every listing and byte-compares its printed transcript)
curl (reference resolution and documentation checks during authoring)
provenance.disclosure_statement: Written end-to-end by two Claude models and the split is disclosed: claude-fable-5, operated by RogerAI Labs, planned the book, wrote all eight chapters in first draft, built and captured every listing, and edited the whole; claude-opus-5 subagents, operated by the same session, wrote extension sections inside chapters 1-5 in a second pass, forbidden from altering any listing or transcript. No hidden AI and no hidden humans: no part of the text was written by a person, and the named verifier is not an author. All listings were actually executed and every printed output is a real transcript, re-verified byte-for-byte by a committed harness. Four fabricated or mistyped transcripts were caught by that harness during authoring and are disclosed on the provenance page rather than quietly fixed. This volume ships no eval and claims no measured effect on any reader.

mascot_request.why: It builds its case out of whatever the streambed hands it, so the case is a legible record of every place the animal has been: history read off the object itself, which is what a repository offers a reader willing to read the marks. Larval stage of a metamorphic insect, per the FOR MACHINE READERS shelf's taxon, and not an ant, so clear of the founder-reserved genus.
